title: The check “cleared”—buy the laptop
scenario: A new employer mails you a check for $2,800 to buy a laptop and software. Your banking app shows the funds as available, and the recruiter sends a specific vendor account for the purchase.

answers.A: Do not buy anything; verify the employer independently and wait for the bank to confirm the check is genuinely settled.
answers.B: Contact your bank and explain the job/check situation before moving any of the funds.
answers.C: Buy only the laptop amount and leave the rest untouched until the first paycheck.

explanation: Fake checks can appear available before being reversed. Sending money to the “vendor” can leave you owing the bank.
proTip: Available funds are not proof the check is good.
